en.name: Cinnamon, ground
en.summary: Ground cinnamon keeps 3–4 years from purchase in a cool, dark cupboard — one of the longest-lasting ground spices, because its aroma sits in a relatively stable oil. That figure is still a flavour window rather than a safety limit.
en.pantry: 3–4 years from purchase in an airtight jar, cool, dark and away from the hob. Cinnamon holds up unusually well for something ground: cinnamaldehyde, the compound that carries the smell, is less volatile than the oils in most herbs, so a jar keeps its character for years rather than months. Nothing grows in it, so a jar past its date is weak rather than unsafe. Cinnamon quills keep longer still, for the usual reason — less exposed surface — and grate easily on a fine microplane.
en.fridge: Ground cinnamon does not belong in the fridge. Ground spices are hygroscopic and a cold jar opened in a warm kitchen picks up condensation each time; damp cinnamon cakes and, in a bad case, moulds. A sealed jar in a cool cupboard is what works.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published either, and freezing brings the same condensation problem in a stronger form. With three to four years in an ordinary cupboard, ground cinnamon is one of the last spices that needs cold storage. If you want it to taste vivid for longer, buy quills and grate what you need.
en.thawing: Not applicable — ground cinnamon is a dry cupboard spice and should not be frozen.
spoilage: Little or no smell when you warm a pinch in your palm.
A flat, woody dustiness instead of sweet warmth.
Caking into hard lumps, meaning moisture has got in.
Mould or a musty smell in a jar that got damp.
tips: Smell before you bake — an old jar adds colour but no flavour.
Buy quills for long storage and grate them on a microplane.
Never dust cinnamon straight from the jar over a steaming pan.
Keep it out of the light and away from the cooker.

faq.q: How long does ground cinnamon keep?
faq.a: 3–4 years from purchase in an airtight jar in a cool, dark cupboard.
No. It fades. An old jar is weak rather than dangerous, and only a damp, mouldy jar should be thrown away.

faq.q: Why does cinnamon last longer than most ground spices?
faq.a: Its main aroma compound is less volatile than the oils in dried herbs and most seed spices, so it escapes more slowly.

zh.name: 肉桂粉
zh.summary: 肉桂粉自購買日起，放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃可放 3～4 年——是最耐放的研磨香料之一，因為它的香氣來自相對穩定的一種精油。即便如此，那仍是風味的窗口，不是安全的上限。
zh.pantry: 氣密罐、陰涼、避光、遠離爐台，自購買日起 3～4 年。以磨好的香料來說，肉桂撐得相當好：帶來香氣的桂皮醛，揮發性比大多數香草裡的精油低，所以一罐肉桂能維持個性好幾年而不是幾個月。裡面長不出東西，所以過期的一罐是味道弱，不是不安全。肉桂捲（桂皮條）更耐放，理由還是那個——暴露的表面少——而且用細刨刀很好磨。
zh.fridge: 肉桂粉不屬於冰箱。研磨香料會吸濕，冰過的罐子每次在溫暖廚房打開都會結露；受潮的肉桂會結塊，嚴重時會發霉。實際有效的做法，是密封罐放在陰涼櫥櫃裡。
zh.freezer: 冷凍同樣沒有期限數據，而且結露問題只會更嚴重。在一般櫥櫃就有三到四年，肉桂粉大概是最不需要低溫保存的香料之一。想讓它的味道更久保持鮮明，就買桂皮條、要多少刨多少。
zh.thawing: 不適用——肉桂粉是乾燥的櫥櫃香料，不應冷凍。
spoilage: 在手心搓熱一小撮，幾乎聞不到味道。
只剩平板的木質灰塵味，而不是甜暖的香氣。
結成硬塊，代表水氣跑進去了。
受潮的罐子長霉或有霉味。
tips: 烘焙前先聞一下——舊罐子只會加上顏色，不會加上味道。
長期保存就買桂皮條，用細刨刀現磨。
不要拿著罐子直接在冒蒸氣的鍋子上方撒。

faq.a: 氣密罐放陰涼避光的櫥櫃，自購買日起 3～4 年。
不會，它是淡掉。舊罐子只是味道弱而不是危險；只有受潮發霉的才該丟。

faq.q: 為什麼肉桂比多數研磨香料耐放？
faq.a: 它主要的香氣成分揮發性比乾燥香草和多數種子類香料低，所以跑得比較慢。
